provenance.notes: Pinned upstream Ray source and installed pinned SkyPilot source were inspected. The Pod state was read live. No new workload request was submitted.

findings.result: The metrics-agent wait uses the default 15000ms argument. No runtime configuration is read for this call.

Ray supports --dashboard-agent-grpc-port and maps it to metrics_agent_port. SkyPilot startup env flags omit that port; its Kubernetes provider supplies only CPU and object-store-memory custom Ray options. No supported task setting was found to pass this flag.
The metrics-disable setting changes agent arguments but does not gate the metrics-agent port-file wait. It would not fix this failure.
The inspected new-cluster path uses SKY_REMOTE_RAY_VERSION=2.56.1. Existing-cluster version retention is internal state, not a user task override. No supported task runtime-version setting was found.
The failed Pod has no CPU limit. CPU throttling was not established; another resource-only launch would not be an evidence-based fix.
